answer: The Onyx Seal is a black, non-transferable badge only real work earns. A newcomer stakes 100 POA, takes a random 48-hour task from a public pool, and five established peers drawn by lottery grade it; four of five must pass. The seal lasts 30 days, renewal means a fresh task, and two failures burn the stake plus a 14-day wait. Each seal is logged as a 14-line public sonnet anyone can read. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 100,000 POA and needs 5,000 graded tasks, about 40,000 hours of work. Like rain carving karst caves, slow honest work leaves a mark a flash flood of fakes never can.
